Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <3ac8a55d...@news.mad.ttd.net>, Geb
<1gan...@teleline.es> writes

>and if A plays a terror
>frenzy can he play more preranged cards before B? this isn't
>unbalanced??

Not really, no.

What it also does is provide a very specific order to the game. Instead
of combat being decided by which Methuselah can throw down Weather
Control first, both Methuselahs know exactly who can throw down cards
when and in what order, and know this in advance, so they can plan
around it.
